subject: Year-end contract reconciliation & VAT split for Q4 usage
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@greenleaf.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 usage reconciliation + VAT handling

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last month. We're moving toward close but hit a snag in the Q4 reconciliation. Our finance team pulled the usage export and there are a couple of line items that pushed us over the committed tier in Dec (short burst testing). We need an adjusted invoice showing: 1) the overage quantity separated from base subscription, and 2) VAT treatment for our EU customers that were billed in December (GreenLeaf has an EU entity).

I'm attaching the usage CSV and a short note from our tax team outlining the VAT IDs for the affected entities. Can Redwood produce a revised end-of-term invoice (final true-up) and clarify whether we should expect VAT on the overage or if reverse-charge applies for those EU entities? Also can you confirm whether we will get a consolidated invoice for the quarter or separate line items per subscription?

We're targeting internal sign-off by next Friday. Appreciate a quick confirmation on next steps and any docs you need from our side.

Attachments: GreenLeaf_Q4_usage_export.csv

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Procurement
GreenLeaf Utilities
liam@greenleaf.io
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@greenleaf.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 usage reconciliation + VAT handling

Liam —

Thanks for the file. Filing this as a billing reconciliation request. Quick notes / ask list so we can move fast:

- We'll produce a revised invoice that separates committed vs overage lines and shows VAT as a distinct line item.
- To determine VAT treatment for the EU entities we need the VAT registration numbers and which legal entity/PO the payments will flow through. The CSV helps but please confirm the legal entity names and VAT IDs for each line.
- Laura (billing) — can you draft the revised invoice and flag any gaps?
- Vivek — looping you as account executive so you're aware of timing for renewal sign-off.

Proposed cadence: we (Redwood billing) will produce a draft revised invoice by EOD Wednesday (tomorrow). Liam, if you can send the VAT ID list and preferred PO number by EOD today that will let us finalize. Also note: if the agreement amendment signed 2027-02-28 (DocuSign) changed billing terms, please attach — we may need that to reflect payment terms and VAT handling.

I'll confirm once Laura uploads the draft.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q4 usage reconciliation + VAT handling

Ben / Vivek —

Got it. I'll pull the usage into our billing system and produce a clean, line-item draft invoice. Actions:

1) I'll map CSV usage rows to subscription IDs and separate committed vs overage (ETA: 24 hours).
2) If customer provides EU VAT IDs and indicates intra-EU B2B sales, we'll mark VAT as reverse-charge (no VAT collected) and show a note on the invoice. If they are consumer-facing or don't supply VAT IDs, we'll apply the local VAT rate per contract.
3) We'll reference the signed amendment (if provided) and ensure payment terms (NET30 vs NET45) are applied as per the latest amendment.

I will upload the draft invoice to the shared drive and paste the link here when ready. Also, confirm whether GreenLeaf wants a single consolidated invoice for the quarter or separate invoices per subscription — default is consolidated unless they request otherwise.

Laura Bennett
Billing Lead, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Nora Kline <nora.k@greenleaf.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam@greenleaf.io>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Q4 usage reconciliation + VAT handling

Hi Laura / Ben,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the signed amendment (signed_amendment_2027-02-28.pdf) and the consolidated VAT registry sheet. We confirm the following:

- Entity: GreenLeaf EU Ltd — VAT ID: EU987654321 (reverse-charge applies).
- Entity: GreenLeaf US Inc — VAT ID: (not applicable).
- Payment preference: single consolidated invoice for Q4 across subscriptions, paid by GreenLeaf Treasury.
- PO number: GL-PO-7782.

I've attached the CSV with a column mapping (row-level legal entity). Please proceed with draft invoice showing: committed subscription, overage quantity and per-unit charge, VAT line showing reverse-charge for GreenLeaf EU Ltd (no VAT collected). Also please include a short note referencing the amendment and new NET45 payment terms.

Attachments: signed_amendment_2027-02-28.pdf
GreenLeaf_Q4_usage_export.csv (updated)

Let us know if you need anything else to issue the final invoice.

Best,
Nora Kline
Finance Operations Manager
GreenLeaf Utilities
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Nora Kline <nora.k@greenleaf.io>, Liam O'Neill <liam@greenleaf.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 usage reconciliation + VAT handling — invoice and next steps

Nora / Liam —

Appreciate the files and the PO. Laura uploaded the draft invoice to the shared Drive (link below) and we've included the split lines you requested. Summary of next steps and timeline:

- Draft invoice (internal ref INV-DL4593-DRAFT) is live: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xExampleShareLink
- Final invoice will be issued after you confirm the draft (please reply with OK or requested edits). Expect final invoice numbering to be INV-2027-03-10.
- VAT: We set GreenLeaf EU Ltd to reverse-charge in the invoice (VAT shown as 0 and a note referencing EU VAT ID EU987654321).
- Payment terms: NET45 per signed amendment; due date will be auto-populated on the final invoice.
- Collection: we can accept payment via ACH (preferred) or wire. If ACH, please provide the remittance file or the bank details and we will send a remittance stub. For wires, our bank details are on the invoice.

Attachments included in the drive: GreenLeaf_Q4_usage_export.csv (updated), signed_amendment_2027-02-28.pdf. I've also attached a small payment checklist for procurement to confirm (filename: GL_payment_checklist.txt).

Could you confirm: 1) OK on the draft invoice, and 2) preferred payment method (ACH/wire) so we can ensure the remittance matches the amendment fields. Once we get confirmation we'll issue final invoice and route to accounting for collection.

If you prefer, we can also generate a payment link (one-time) for credit card payment, but note that will include a fees note.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
